claims.text: Development and autism: standardized developmental screening at the 9-, 18- and 30-month well-child visits; autism spectrum disorder screening at the 18- and 24-month visits.
claims.quote: Standardized developmental screenings should be conducted at the 9-, 18-, and 30-month well-child visits. In addition, physicians should administer a screening for autism spectrum disorder during the 18- and 24-month health supervision visits.

claims.text: Mother's depression: screen per the AAP report on recognizing and managing perinatal depression in pediatric practice.
claims.quote: 11. Screening should occur per "Incorporating Recognition and Management of Perinatal Depression Into Pediatric Practice"

claims.text: Behavioral and social-emotional: the screening should be family centered and may include caregiver emotional and mental health concerns and social determinants of health, racism, poverty and relational health.
claims.quote: The screening should be family centered and may include asking about caregiver emotional and mental health concerns and social determinants of health, racism, poverty, and relational health.

claims.text: Depression and suicide risk: screen adolescents, making every effort to preserve their confidentiality.
claims.quote: 16. Screen adolescents for depression and suicide risk, making every effort to preserve confidentiality of the adolescent.

claims.text: Substance use: CRAFFT (crafft.org) is a recommended tool for alcohol, tobacco and nicotine, marijuana and other substances, including opioids; with concern for substance or opioid use, consider recommending or prescribing naloxone.
claims.quote: 15. A recommended tool to assess use of alcohol, tobacco and nicotine, marijuana, and other substances, including opioids is available at http://crafft.org. If there is a concern for substance or opioid use, providers should consider recommending or prescribing Naloxone
